deps.name: Git
deps.used_for: Lists a project's files, and reads any file exactly as it stood at the map's pinned commit.

evidence.why: Asks git for the tracked and untracked files, so ignored output never enters the map.
Reads a file's contents at the map's commit, so the code viewer shows the mapped version.
Reads the commit a map is pinned to when a build is stamped.
Checks whether a recorded commit is an ancestor of the current one.

deps.name: Local file system
deps.used_for: Holds every project's map folder, the tool's own environment, and the remembered list of projects.

evidence.why: Writes the finished map beside the project's code.
Saves the list of projects the server offers on its landing page.

deps.name: Web browser
deps.used_for: Opens and draws the map viewer page for a person on this machine.

evidence.why: Opens the server's landing page in the person's browser when asked to.
The start target launches the server and opens the page.

deps.not_an_interface: The browser is the client a person reaches the viewer through, not a far side of its own.

deps.name: Code editor
deps.used_for: Receives a file and a line from the map, so a person opens that exact spot in their editor.

evidence.why: Lists the editors the viewer can hand a file to, each with its own address form.
Hands the chosen editor the file and line, which the operating system opens.

deps.name: GitHub
deps.used_for: Shows a mapped file on the web, pinned to the commit the map was built at.

evidence.why: Builds the web address of a mapped file at the map's commit.
Opens that address in a new tab when no editor is chosen.
Bug and idea reports, and private security reports, are filed on the code host.

deps.name: Coding agent
deps.used_for: Runs the installed skill that drives a map build, and names the conversation a build is stamped with.

evidence.why: Copies the skill into each agent's skills folder with this clone's path filled in.
Reads the conversation identifier the agent publishes, so a map records which chat produced it.
Reads the same conversation identifier before a build review is allowed to start.

deps.name: jsDelivr
deps.used_for: Serves the two drawing libraries the viewer page loads in the browser.

evidence.why: The page loads the diagram library from this host, pinned to a version and a checksum.

deps.not_an_interface: Its scripts are fetched into the viewer page and become part of it, so no data crosses a surface.

deps.name: Mermaid
deps.used_for: Draws every diagram on the viewer page from the text the tool generates.

evidence.why: Loaded as one self-contained bundle so the checksum covers the whole library.
Generates the diagram text this library turns into a picture.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the viewer page loads and becomes part of.

deps.name: svg-pan-zoom
deps.used_for: Lets a person pan and zoom a drawn diagram in the viewer.

evidence.why: Loaded from the delivery network, pinned to a version and a checksum.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the viewer page loads and becomes part of.

deps.name: tree-sitter
deps.used_for: Reads symbols and imports out of source files in many languages during the first pass.

evidence.why: Builds a parser for one language, and gives up quietly when the library is absent.
Declared as an optional extra, so the core of the tool stays free of outside packages.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the code survey imports and becomes part of.

deps.name: tree-sitter language pack
deps.used_for: Supplies the per-language grammars the source parser needs.

evidence.why: Tries to load the pack, and records why it failed when it is missing.
Fetches one language's grammar for the parser.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the code survey imports and becomes part of.

deps.name: pytest
deps.used_for: Runs the whole test suite, which is the first half of the checks a change must pass.

evidence.why: The checks target runs the suite with no folder named, so no tests are silently skipped.
Declares the two test folders that a bare run collects.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the checks run under and become part of.

deps.name: pyright
deps.used_for: Checks the tool's Python types, which is the second half of the checks a change must pass.

evidence.why: The checks target runs the type checker after the tests, so one run reports everything.
Tells the type checker where the two source folders live.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the checks run under and become part of.

deps.name: Playwright
deps.used_for: Drives a real browser for the one test file that can see a viewer bug on screen.

evidence.why: Declared as optional at run time, so the on-screen viewer test skips itself when the browser is missing.

deps.not_an_interface: A library one test run drives and becomes part of.

deps.name: setuptools
deps.used_for: Builds and installs the tool from the repo, including the viewer files that ship with it.

evidence.why: Maps the two source folders onto the two installed packages.
Ships the viewer page, its styles and its script inside the installed package.

deps.not_an_interface: A library the install uses and becomes part of.

config.purpose: Allows a run to read or write coyodex's own map, which is refused by default.
config.default: not set, so the clone's own map is protected
config.per_env: Set by hand for one session, only when mapping coyodex itself.

config.purpose: Names the clone whose method files and templates a run should read.
config.per_env: Same on every machine unless a person points at a second clone.

config.purpose: Stops a finished build from adding its project to the server's remembered list.
config.default: not set, so every build registers its project
config.per_env: Set by the method-quality eval so its runs do not pollute the list.

config.purpose: Names the conversation a map build is stamped with.
config.default: published by the coding agent, not set by hand
config.per_env: Same everywhere; a build review refuses to run without it.

config.purpose: Port the local map server listens on.
config.per_env: Same on every machine unless a person overrides it when starting the server.

config.purpose: Points a child process at this checkout's tools instead of another checkout's.
config.default: unset, which falls back to the installed package
config.per_env: Rewritten to an absolute path at test start, so a second checkout is never tested by mistake.

deployment.runs_on: the person's own machine, inside a folder-local Python environment the repo owns
deployment.exposed_as: a command typed in a terminal, and called by the coding agent
deployment.config_source: Installed in editable mode from this repo by the dependency target in the Makefile, so the repo stays the source of truth. Requires Python 3.10 or newer.

deployment.runs_on: the person's own machine, listening only on the loopback address
deployment.exposed_as: a local web address on port 8765
deployment.config_source: Started by the start target in the Makefile, which passes the port from a make variable. A second target starts the same server with live reload for someone working on the viewer.

deployment.runs_on: two skills folders in the person's home directory, one per agent family
deployment.exposed_as: a slash command inside the coding agent
deployment.config_source: Copied by the install target into the Claude and cross-agent skills folders, with this clone's absolute path filled in. The method files stay read from the repo, so they evolve without reinstalling.

deployment.runs_on: the same two skills folders in the person's home directory
deployment.exposed_as: a separate slash command, for the developer of coyodex only
deployment.config_source: Installed by its own target, deliberately not by the plain install target, so the developer surface is never a side effect of setting up the tool.

deployment.runs_on: the same two skills folders in the person's home directory
deployment.exposed_as: a separate slash command, for the developer of coyodex only
deployment.config_source: Installed by its own target, or together with the eval skill by the developer target. It reads its recipe from this clone.
